description: Synthetic fixture for the A03 path (user corrects a term -> glossary update -> better later dictation). Every transcript, project id, and utterance here is invented; there is no real audio or user data. echoPilot/sqlite/jsonPerson carry the learned entries and the utterances that must (or must not) be corrected; longDictation carries one bounded, overlapping ASR window sequence whose committed text must concatenate without a duplicated overlap.

echoPilot.unrelatedUtterance: echo the pilot log to the console

sqlite.matchingUtterance: run the sequel lite migration on staging
sqlite.matchingCorrected: run the SQLite migration on staging

jsonPerson.rejectedUtterance: tell Jason the deploy is blocked
jsonPerson.rejectedBadCorrection: tell JSON the deploy is blocked
jsonPerson.rejectedFollowUp: tell Jason the deploy is blocked again

overBudgetWindow.text: this window exceeded the maximum fifteen second audio budget

windows.text: we need to deploy echo pilot across the staging fleet before the review on friday
the review on friday will cover the glossary pipeline and the retention policy for the new release
the new release also changes the correction thresholds and the overlay latency budget for dictation
for dictation we will measure the warm path and the harmful edits on the held out corpus
the held out corpus will be scored after the freeze
after the freeze we will publish the release notes and archive the old fixtures
